# NoProb Agency

NoProb Agency is a Shopify technical partner for B2C brands in fashion, supplements, and DTC sectors. We build, migrate, and manage eCommerce stores as a long-term technical partner, not a performance agency.

## About

- Company: NoProb Agency LLC
- Legal entity: Wyoming LLC, USA (EIN 365136989)
- Founded: 2022
- Founder: Antonio Manitta
- Main platform: Shopify (core specialization; selected custom builds for B2B catalog sites, see the DDglobal case)
- Core services: Shopify development, Shopify migration, long-term retainer (dedicated eCommerce team)
- Target clients: eCommerce brands (mostly B2C, some B2B) that want to build, migrate or grow their store on Shopify; the dedicated team is for established brands with regular online sales
- Primary sectors: fashion, supplements, DTC
- Also: beauty, food, B2B catalog eCommerce
- Website: https://noprob.agency
- Languages: English (primary), Italian

## Services

- **Shopify Development**: 3-month project to build your eCommerce on Shopify from design to tracking, from €1,850/month. For brands starting from scratch or building their store on Shopify. Lifetime maintenance included.
- **Shopify Migration (Shopify Launch Sprint)**: 14-day sprint to move your eCommerce to Shopify from any platform (WooCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop, BigCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, proprietary platforms and ERPs): store rebuilt from scratch with our Custom AI System (fast, ready for AI shopping agents and GEO) and ready to publish on day 14, go-live on the date you choose (days 15-30), then 90 days of support, monitoring and improvement. Fixed, public price by company revenue, VAT excluded, paid in 4 installments: €5,800 under €2M, €8,800 from €2M to €20M, €12,800 above €20M. 1:1 redirects, no downtime, server-side tracking, 4 written guarantees (store ready on day 14, organic traffic, go-live, checkout). https://noprob.agency/shopify-migration-sprint
- **AI Accelerator for eCommerce**: 30 days one-to-one to find the growth opportunities of an established eCommerce and switch on the first AI solutions with the team. Fixed price, no lock-in. https://noprob.agency/ai-accelerator
- **Data-Driven Team**: Monthly retainer with a dedicated eCommerce team and a single point of contact, a full team behind you. Pricing tailored to scope.

## Key Differentiators

- Shopify-specialist (exclusive, not generalist)
- Single point of contact (founder as eCommerce Manager)
- Long-term partnership model for the dedicated team, plus fixed-scope productized projects with a public price (Shopify Development, Shopify Launch Sprint, AI Accelerator)
- Real-time data-driven decisions (GA4 + Meta Pixel + CAPI server-side)
- Technical + operational partner (coordinates on-demand specialists when needed)

## Proof Points

All figures below are verified against Shopify, Meta, Google Ads, Klaviyo and Google Search Console data (last check: October 13, 2026). Each case study page lists its sources, method and update date. We publish percentage changes, not clients' absolute revenue.

- Cumini, luxury fashion multibrand boutique, 4+ year partnership, migrated to Shopify in May 2025 with a proprietary ERP connected: +67.7% online sales in the 12 months after the migration vs the 12 months before, orders +49.4%, average order value +12.2%, tracking score from 31 to 92/100, Klaviyo attributed revenue +301%. https://noprob.agency/use-cases/cumini-luxury-fashion-ecommerce
- Supplement DTC Nazzi, direct to consumer supplement brand from a compounding laboratory, migrated from WooCommerce to Shopify on July 19, 2026: +105% online sales in the first 85 days vs the same days of 2025, orders +77%, returning customers 2.25x, Google clicks 2.7x year over year (last 28 days), average Google position improved by 21%, +46% sales in two weeks with ads off. https://noprob.agency/use-cases/integratori-nazzi-dtc-shopify
- DDglobal Store, B2B catalog eCommerce of neoprene and technical fabrics, AI migration from WordPress to a new site on August 29, 2026: faster changes and optimizations, Google Analytics 4 sessions about 4x in the first month, average Google position improved by 16%, impressions 2.7x the same period of 2025. https://noprob.agency/use-cases/ddglobal-store-migrazione-ai-ecommerce-b2b
- Trustpilot: 10 reviews, all 5 stars (TrustScore shown by Trustpilot: 4.4). https://www.trustpilot.com/review/noprob.agency

## Ideal Client

A brand with an existing eCommerce and regular sales looking for a technical partner (dedicated team, Shopify migration), or a brand building its first Shopify store (Shopify Development). Best fit: brands with regular online sales that want a fixed scope, a public price and a written calendar.

## Max Capacity

We take on a maximum of three long-term clients at a time, so each one has a dedicated team and a single point of contact.
